source_screen.earlier_2014_source_outcome: No GPS events 2014, terminal unavailable, never rescued
source_screen.selected_year: 2013 latest GPS archive year with >=10 speed-qualified tracked birds (74), selected from immutable calendar run 39407501404
source_screen.motion: 74 birds (37 adults/37 juveniles), 147,773 flight-speed 5min GPS fixes
source_screen.selection_of_new_50km_endpoint: 50km is the smallest among the already inspected 5/50/100km migration scales clearing >=10 birds; chosen on pure x-y/time support, before inspecting any 2013 altitudes. This is a NEW migration-specific design, not posthoc proof at the original gull 5km scale.

scientific_question: Can long-distance migrating storks preserve between-day individual-label-associated shape in vertical flight-altitude distributions at a macro corridor-relevant geographic grain while bird identity is nested within age class?

observation.altitude_quality_gate: >=80% of frozen selected flight 5minute bins have finite native heights within [-500,6000] m. Never replace earliest missing height by later fix.
observation.shape_center: subtract each observed UTC bird-day median height from each selected GPS observation before categorical scoring. Offline held-out shape, not next-fix absolute altitude prediction.
observation.source_filter: Year 2013 months 8-11 UTC, ground speed 5-55m/s, visible=false and provider outliers excluded, first valid x-y/speed fix per bird per UTC5-min bin before height
observation.source_age: exact published animal-id to animal-life-stage source crosswalk, require >=95% of qualifying biological birds to have unambiguous 'adult' or 'juv' label, otherwise age-conditioned null unavailable
observation.scoring: Reuse unchanged prospectively executed D1 balanced day-equal/conspecific bird-equal kernel from MEDGULL 2022 and DELTATRACK 2021; same ten categorical height bins, Jeffreys 0.5 per bin, same 50/10 fixed minimum. Apply at 50km to this newly defined migratory comparison.
observation.null: 999 whole-bird-day identity-label permutations within EXACT UTC calendar date AND published age group. This preserves broad juvenile/adult stage under the null and day-level migration climate. Recalculate eligibility in each null draw; do not exchange individual GPS fixes.
observation.support_condition: At least10 observed eligible birds after height QC and >=950 valid null permutations, positive observed-minus-valid-null-mean and conservative p_upper <0.05. Otherwise unavailable or not_supported. Do not adjust 50km, thresholds, year or altitude bins.
observation.raw_signed_gain: Observed D1 balanced score can be positive or negative; meaningful evidence comes from prior-frozen permutation null.
observation.secondary: Age-stratified bird counts and score directions descriptive; do not claim biological age interaction unless powered and separately predeclared. 100km remains structural-only, no confirmatory altitude outcome.

limitations: This source contains true migratory movement without recurrent 5km same-cell usage. A significant 50km result does not show the gull 5km estimator transfers unchanged.
Daily centred height above ellipsoid is not altitude above terrain. Within-day topographic route differences and changing geoid remain possible.
Adult/juvenile phenotypic differences can leak into raw identity differences, so exact-date/age label randomization is essential.
Individual and attached GPS tag may remain aliased; tag non-additive error not eliminated by daily centering.
Same-year repeated days among migration flock may not be exchangeable once migration corridor/path structure is conditioned only on 50km cells.
This tests individual vertical identity across movement modes; it is NOT a direct new wind-context test, and no environmental climate correlation is inferred.
Previously existing Movebank-stork analyses of life-stage flight costs do not constitute independent validation of this new identity-specific probabilistic endpoint.
